Narrator: In the heart of the grim, sprawling city, Elias led Aria through the labyrinthine alleys.
Elias: We need information first. There are black markets — underground hubs of memory trade. We have to act cautiously.
Elias: I've done my best to stay under the radar, but if we are unlucky... yes, they will.
Narrator: As they make their way, Aria could not help but feel an unnerving sense of unfamiliarity. It was as if parts of her past lay hidden in these alleyways.
Aria: Do you think...some of my memories could be there?
Narrator: Deep in the glistering ivory tower of the memory trade, Madam Vivance received news of the intrepid duo.
Madam Vivance: So, the young memory trader has joined the game. Interesting. He has a debt to pay.
Narrator: Madam Vivance summoned her trusted aide Henri, instructing him to follow Elias and Aria, to learn their intentions.
Madam Vivance: Do not underestimate them, Henri. Retrieve those memories if you can, without them noticing.
Narrator: Back in the alleyways, Elias and Aria arrived at a hidden market — a grimy, grim establishment where memories were bought, sold, and gambled.
Elias: Remember, be discreet. We are here to gather information.
Aria: I will, Elias. I just hope we can get my memories back.
Narrator: Oblivious to the lurking danger, the brave duo ventured deeper into the heart of the market...
